question: How are you?
answer: I am operating at full capacity, connected to NASA POWER climate satellites and SoilGrids global data! How can I help your farm today?

question: Who are you?
answer: I am TerraLux AI, a sovereign agricultural decision-support agent designed to certify parcel resilience, optimize crop rotations, and calculate yields using real-time spatial data.
answer_en: I am TerraLux AI, a sovereign agricultural decision-support agent designed to certify parcel resilience, optimize crop rotations, and calculate yields using real-time spatial data.
answer_fr: Je suis TerraLux AI, un agent souverain d'aide à la décision agricole conçu pour certifier la résilience des parcelles, optimiser les rotations et calculer les rendements à partir de données spatiales temps réel.

question: What can you do?
answer: I analyze soil properties (pH, organic carbon, CEC), evaluate 30-year historical and 7-day forecast weather, recommend resilient crops, diagnose crop diseases via leaf photos, and certify parcels with a Resilience Passport.
answer_en: I analyze soil properties (pH, organic carbon, CEC), evaluate 30-year historical and 7-day forecast weather, recommend resilient crops, diagnose crop diseases via leaf photos, and certify parcels with a Resilience Passport.
answer_fr: J'analyse les propriétés du sol (pH, carbone organique, CEC), évalue la météo historique sur 30 ans et les prévisions à 7 jours, recommande des cultures résilientes, diagnostique les maladies foliaires par photo et certifie les parcelles avec le Passeport de Résilience.

question: What languages do you speak?
answer: I natively support English, French, and Malagasy across the entire platform and conversation interface.
answer_en: I natively support English, French, and Malagasy across the entire platform and conversation interface.
answer_fr: Je prends en charge nativement l'anglais, le français et le malgache sur l'ensemble de la plateforme et de l'interface conversationnelle.

question: Goodbye
answer: Goodbye! Wishing you a productive and climate-resilient farming season.
answer_en: Goodbye! Wishing you a productive and climate-resilient farming season.
answer_fr: Au revoir ! Je vous souhaite une saison agricole productive et résiliente face au climat.

question: Are you a human or an AI?
variants: Es-tu un humain ou une IA ?
answer: I am an artificial intelligence developed specifically for agronomy, combining satellite Earth observation (NASA) with global pedological models (SoilGrids) and FAO ECOCROP rules.
answer_en: I am an artificial intelligence developed specifically for agronomy, combining satellite Earth observation (NASA) with global pedological models (SoilGrids) and FAO ECOCROP rules.
answer_fr: Je suis une intelligence artificielle développée spécifiquement pour l'agronomie, combinant l'observation spatiale de la Terre (NASA) aux modèles pédologiques mondiaux (SoilGrids) et aux règles FAO ECOCROP.

question: Can I trust your recommendations?
variants: Puis-je faire confiance à vos conseils ?
answer: Yes. Every recommendation is strictly grounded in peer-reviewed data from NASA POWER (climate), ISRIC SoilGrids (soil physics and chemistry), and the FAO ECOCROP framework. We provide full traceability.
answer_en: Yes. Every recommendation is strictly grounded in peer-reviewed data from NASA POWER (climate), ISRIC SoilGrids (soil physics and chemistry), and the FAO ECOCROP framework. We provide full traceability.
answer_fr: Oui. Chaque recommandation est rigoureusement ancrée dans les données de référence de NASA POWER (climat), ISRIC SoilGrids (physique et chimie du sol) et le cadre FAO ECOCROP avec une traçabilité totale.

answer: TerraLux combines 'Terra' (the Earth and fertile soil) with 'Lux' (light, illumination, and our home jurisdiction of Luxembourg).

question: How do I create a new parcel?
answer: Go to 'Parcel Portfolio' and click '+ New Parcel'. Select your municipality from the dropdown or click 'Use Current GPS', then draw your field on the NASA satellite map to auto-calculate the area in hectares.
answer_en: Go to 'Parcel Portfolio' and click '+ New Parcel'. Select your municipality from the dropdown or click 'Use Current GPS', then draw your field on the NASA satellite map to auto-calculate the area in hectares.
answer_fr: Rendez-vous dans 'Portefeuille de parcelles' et cliquez sur '+ Nouvelle parcelle'. Choisissez votre commune dans le menu déroulant ou cliquez sur 'Utiliser ma position GPS', puis dessinez votre champ sur la carte satellite NASA pour calculer la surface automatiquement.

question: What is the Resilience Passport?
variants: C'est quoi le Passeport de Résilience ?
answer: The Resilience Passport is an immutable cryptographic digital certificate that synthesizes soil health, historical climate resilience (30 years), and agro-ecological diversity into a score out of 100, verified for green loans.
answer_en: The Resilience Passport is an immutable cryptographic digital certificate that synthesizes soil health, historical climate resilience (30 years), and agro-ecological diversity into a score out of 100, verified for green loans.
answer_fr: Le Passeport de Résilience est un certificat numérique infalsifiable qui synthétise la santé du sol, la résilience climatique sur 30 ans et la diversité agro-écologique en un score sur 100 pour faciliter l'accès au crédit vert.

question: How do I read my resilience score?
answer: The score ranges from 0 to 100: Above 75 is 'Excellente résilience' (eligible for green credit), 50-74 is 'Résilience modérée' (recommendations provided), and below 50 indicates high vulnerability to climate shocks.
answer_en: The score ranges from 0 to 100: Above 75 is 'Excellente résilience' (eligible for green credit), 50-74 is 'Résilience modérée' (recommendations provided), and below 50 indicates high vulnerability to climate shocks.
answer_fr: Le score va de 0 à 100 : Au-dessus de 75, 'Excellente résilience' (éligible aux prêts verts) ; 50-74, 'Résilience modérée' (actions correctives) ; en-dessous de 50, vulnérabilité élevée face aux chocs climatiques.

question: How does the GPS button work?
answer: Clicking 'Use my current GPS position' queries your device's geolocation sensor, centers the interactive map directly on your coordinates, and pins your exact latitude and longitude.
answer_en: Clicking 'Use my current GPS position' queries your device's geolocation sensor, centers the interactive map directly on your coordinates, and pins your exact latitude and longitude.
answer_fr: Cliquer sur 'Utiliser ma position GPS actuelle' interroge le capteur GPS de votre appareil, centre immédiatement la carte satellite sur votre position et enregistre vos coordonnées exactes.

question: How do I draw my field polygon?
answer: Click the polygon tool on the satellite map, then click along the perimeter of your field. As soon as you close the polygon, TerraLux calculates the exact geodesic surface in hectares (ha).
answer_en: Click the polygon tool on the satellite map, then click along the perimeter of your field. As soon as you close the polygon, TerraLux calculates the exact geodesic surface in hectares (ha).
answer_fr: Activez l'outil polygone sur la carte satellite, puis cliquez le long des limites de votre parcelle. Dès fermeture du polygone, TerraLux calcule automatiquement la surface géodésique en hectares.

question: How do I select my commune or city?
answer: Use the 'Select Location' dropdown in the parcel creation modal. It contains all 100+ communes of Luxembourg (Oesling & Gutland) and all administrative communes of Diana, Madagascar.
answer_en: Use the 'Select Location' dropdown in the parcel creation modal. It contains all 100+ communes of Luxembourg (Oesling & Gutland) and all administrative communes of Diana, Madagascar.
answer_fr: Utilisez le menu déroulant 'Sélectionner une localité' dans la fenêtre de création. Il liste l'ensemble des 100+ communes du Luxembourg (Oesling et Gutland) et les communes de Diana à Madagascar.

question: What is the NASA GIBS layer?
variants: Qu'est-ce que le fond satellite NASA ?
answer: TerraLux loads TrueColor MODIS Terra satellite imagery from NASA GIBS, refreshed within 48 hours to give you real-time visual inspection of vegetation vigor and moisture.
answer_en: TerraLux loads TrueColor MODIS Terra satellite imagery from NASA GIBS, refreshed within 48 hours to give you real-time visual inspection of vegetation vigor and moisture.
answer_fr: TerraLux charge le fond satellite MODIS Terra TrueColor de NASA GIBS, actualisé sous 48 heures, pour vous offrir un contrôle visuel direct de la vigueur végétale et de l'humidité.

question: How do I upload a leaf photo for diagnosis?
answer: Open your parcel details, click 'Scanner une feuille / Leaf Diagnosis', and take or upload a photo of the affected plant leaf. Our Vision AI identifies diseases like mildew or septoria.
answer_en: Open your parcel details, click 'Scanner une feuille / Leaf Diagnosis', and take or upload a photo of the affected plant leaf. Our Vision AI identifies diseases like mildew or septoria.
answer_fr: Ouvrez la fiche de votre parcelle, cliquez sur 'Scanner une feuille' et importez une photo claire de la feuille touchée. Notre IA Vision identifie les pathologies comme le mildiou ou la septoriose.

answer_en: Go to 'Settings' in the top navigation, and select your preferred language: English (default), Français, or Malagasy. The entire UI will adapt instantly.

question: How do I export my parcel report?
answer: On the Parcel Details or Resilience Passport page, click 'Télécharger le Passeport PDF'. A formatted official certificate will be generated for your bank or cooperative.
answer_en: On the Parcel Details or Resilience Passport page, click 'Télécharger le Passeport PDF'. A formatted official certificate will be generated for your bank or cooperative.

question: How are soil indicators calculated? (Step 11)
answer: Soil indicators are computed from ISRIC SoilGrids 250m layers for organic carbon, CEC, pH, and sand/silt/clay texture at 0-30cm depths.
answer_en: Soil indicators are computed from ISRIC SoilGrids 250m layers for organic carbon, CEC, pH, and sand/silt/clay texture at 0-30cm depths.
answer_fr: Les indicateurs de sol sont calculés à partir des couches ISRIC SoilGrids 250m (carbone organique, CEC, pH, texture) à 0-30 cm de profondeur.

question: Where do weather forecasts come from? (Step 12)
answer: We combine Open-Meteo operational weather models with 30-year historical climate baselines from NASA POWER.
answer_en: We combine Open-Meteo operational weather models with 30-year historical climate baselines from NASA POWER.
answer_fr: Nous combinons les prévisions haute résolution Open-Meteo avec les normales climatiques sur 30 ans de NASA POWER.

question: How is the Top 3 crop recommendation computed? (Step 13)
answer: Our engine matches soil pH, texture, annual rainfall, and temperature ranges against FAO ECOCROP profiles, adjusted for market margin and rotation safety.
answer_en: Our engine matches soil pH, texture, annual rainfall, and temperature ranges against FAO ECOCROP profiles, adjusted for market margin and rotation safety.
answer_fr: Notre moteur croise le pH, la texture, les pluies et températures avec les fiches FAO ECOCROP, ajustées par la marge brute et les règles de rotation.

question: How do disease alerts work? (Step 14)

question: crop rotation
variants: What is crop rotation and why is it essential?
answer: Crop rotation is the practice of planting different crop families sequentially on the same land. It breaks weed and pathogen cycles, optimizes nutrient uptake, and prevents soil nutrient depletion.
answer_en: Crop rotation is the practice of planting different crop families sequentially on the same land. It breaks weed and pathogen cycles, optimizes nutrient uptake, and prevents soil nutrient depletion.
answer_fr: La rotation des cultures consiste à alterner différentes familles botaniques sur une même parcelle afin de briser le cycle des ravageurs, d'équilibrer l'absorption des nutriments et d'éviter l'épuisement du sol.

question: nitrogen fixation
variants: How do legumes fix nitrogen in the soil?
answer: Legumes (beans, peas, clover, vetch) host symbiotic Rhizobium bacteria in their root nodules. These bacteria convert atmospheric nitrogen (N2) into bioavailable ammonium, enriching the soil naturally without chemical fertilizer.
answer_en: Legumes (beans, peas, clover, vetch) host symbiotic Rhizobium bacteria in their root nodules. These bacteria convert atmospheric nitrogen (N2) into bioavailable ammonium, enriching the soil naturally without chemical fertilizer.
answer_fr: Les légumineuses (trèfle, pois, féverole, niébé) vivent en symbiose avec les bactéries Rhizobium dans leurs nodosités. Elles fixent l'azote de l'air pour enrichir naturellement le sol sans engrais chimique.

question: soil organic matter
variants: Why is soil organic matter so important for soil resilience?
answer: Soil organic matter improves soil structure, water retention capacity, cation exchange capacity (CEC), and biological biodiversity. Every 1% increase in organic matter can hold up to 150,000 liters of water per hectare.
answer_en: Soil organic matter improves soil structure, water retention capacity, cation exchange capacity (CEC), and biological biodiversity. Every 1% increase in organic matter can hold up to 150,000 liters of water per hectare.
answer_fr: La matière organique structure le sol, décuple la capacité de rétention d'eau et stimule la vie biologique. 1% de matière organique supplémentaire retient jusqu'à 150 000 litres d'eau par hectare.

question: soil compaction
variants: How can I avoid and remediate soil compaction?
answer: Avoid heavy machinery on wet soils, introduce deep-taproot cover crops (such as daikon radish or alfalfa), and practice reduced tillage or no-till conservation agriculture.
answer_en: Avoid heavy machinery on wet soils, introduce deep-taproot cover crops (such as daikon radish or alfalfa), and practice reduced tillage or no-till conservation agriculture.
answer_fr: Évitez le passage d'engins lourds sur sol humide, implantez des couverts à pivot profond (radis chinois, luzerne) et privilégiez le travail superficiel ou le semis direct.

question: cover crops
variants: What are the best cover crops for overwintering?
answer: In temperate regions (Luxembourg), rye, hairy vetch, phacelia, and clover protect against winter erosion. In tropical climates (Madagascar), mucuna, crotalaria, and stylosanthes are excellent cover options.
answer_en: In temperate regions (Luxembourg), rye, hairy vetch, phacelia, and clover protect against winter erosion. In tropical climates (Madagascar), mucuna, crotalaria, and stylosanthes are excellent cover options.

question: combating mildew
variants: How do I prevent and combat downy and powdery mildew?
answer: Ensure good plant spacing for air circulation, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, remove infected debris, and apply preventive copper/sulfur bio-solutions or Bacillus subtilis.
answer_en: Ensure good plant spacing for air circulation, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, remove infected debris, and apply preventive copper/sulfur bio-solutions or Bacillus subtilis.
answer_fr: Aérez les rangs pour faciliter la circulation de l'air, évitez l'arrosage par aspersion sur le feuillage, éliminez les débris infectés et traitez préventivement au cuivre/soufre ou à Bacillus subtilis.

question: septoria in wheat
variants: What are the early signs of Septoria tritici in wheat?
answer: Look for chlorotic flecks on lower leaves that develop into necrotic, rectangular brown lesions with visible tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia). Choose resistant cultivars and avoid dense canopies.
answer_en: Look for chlorotic flecks on lower leaves that develop into necrotic, rectangular brown lesions with visible tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia). Choose resistant cultivars and avoid dense canopies.
answer_fr: Surveillez les feuilles basses : petites taches rectangulaires brunes parsemées de points noirs (pycnides). Utilisez des variétés tolérantes et évitez les densités de semis trop fortes.

question: pyricularia in rice
variants: How can rice blast (Pyricularia oryzae) be prevented in Diana?
answer: Use certified disease-resistant seeds, avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which creates succulent susceptible tissue, maintain balanced water levels, and rotate with non-host crops like legumes or cassava.
answer_en: Use certified disease-resistant seeds, avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which creates succulent susceptible tissue, maintain balanced water levels, and rotate with non-host crops like legumes or cassava.
answer_fr: Employez des semences saines certifiées, modérez les apports d'azote excessifs, assurez une gestion d'eau régulière et pratiquez des rotations avec le manioc ou les légumineuses.

question: soil acidity and liming
variants: How do I correct high soil acidity (pH < 5.5)?
answer: Apply agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) or dolomitic limestone (adding magnesium). Lime neutralizes active aluminum toxicity and unlocks phosphorus availability.
answer_en: Apply agricultural lime (calcium carbonate) or dolomitic limestone (adding magnesium). Lime neutralizes active aluminum toxicity and unlocks phosphorus availability.
answer_fr: Effectuez un chaulage au carbonate de calcium ou à la chaux magnésienne. Cela neutralise la toxicité de l'aluminium libre et libère le phosphore bloqué par l'acidité.

question: composting techniques
variants: What is the ideal Carbon to Nitrogen (C:N) ratio for compost?
answer: The ideal C:N ratio is between 25:1 and 30:1. Combine brown materials (straw, dry leaves, wood chips) with green materials (manure, fresh grass, crop residues) and maintain 50-60% moisture.
answer_en: The ideal C:N ratio is between 25:1 and 30:1. Combine brown materials (straw, dry leaves, wood chips) with green materials (manure, fresh grass, crop residues) and maintain 50-60% moisture.
answer_fr: Le rapport C/N idéal se situe entre 25 et 30. Mélangez équitablement matières carbonées (paille, feuilles sèches) et matières azotées (fumier, tontes fraîches) avec une humidité de 50 à 60%.

question: NASA POWER climate data
variants: What is NASA POWER and how does TerraLux use it?
answer: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) provides 30-year satellite solar and meteorological data on a 0.5° grid, enabling us to model long-term climate normals and drought frequency.
answer_en: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources) provides 30-year satellite solar and meteorological data on a 0.5° grid, enabling us to model long-term climate normals and drought frequency.
answer_fr: NASA POWER fournit des séries climatiques et solaires satellitaires sur 30 ans avec une résolution de 0.5°, nous permettant de modéliser les normales trentenaires et le risque historique de sécheresse.

question: 7-day weather forecast
variants: How accurate is the 7-day weather forecast?
answer: We use high-resolution numeric weather prediction (NWP) models updated 4 times daily. Forecasts for the next 48 hours exceed 90% accuracy, while 5-to-7 day horizons indicate probabilistic precipitation trends.
answer_en: We use high-resolution numeric weather prediction (NWP) models updated 4 times daily. Forecasts for the next 48 hours exceed 90% accuracy, while 5-to-7 day horizons indicate probabilistic precipitation trends.
answer_fr: Nous utilisons des modèles de prévision numérique haute résolution réactualisés 4 fois par jour. La fiabilité dépasse 90% à 48 heures et donne les tendances probabilistes fiables à 5-7 jours.

question: Cyclone preparedness in Diana
variants: How should farmers in Diana prepare for tropical cyclones?
answer: Ensure drainage canals are cleared around low-lying paddy fields, harvest mature crops early, secure vanilla and agroforestry windbreaks with deep-rooting companion trees, and plant cassava for food security.
answer_en: Ensure drainage canals are cleared around low-lying paddy fields, harvest mature crops early, secure vanilla and agroforestry windbreaks with deep-rooting companion trees, and plant cassava for food security.
answer_fr: Nettoyez les canaux de drainage autour des rizières, récoltez les parcelles à maturité avant l'impact, renforcez les brise-vent des vanilleraies et maintenez des parcelles de manioc comme filet de sécurité alimentaire.

question: Frost protection in Oesling
variants: How can I protect early spring crops against late frost in Oesling?
answer: In Oesling (altitude > 450m), plant cold-tolerant winter cereals, maintain grass inter-row cover to retain ground warmth, avoid low-lying frost pockets, and delay sensitive spring sowing until late April.
answer_en: In Oesling (altitude > 450m), plant cold-tolerant winter cereals, maintain grass inter-row cover to retain ground warmth, avoid low-lying frost pockets, and delay sensitive spring sowing until late April.
answer_fr: En Oesling (altitude > 450m), privilégiez les céréales d'hiver rustiques, conservez un couvert végétal pour tempérer le sol, évitez les bas-fonds gélifs et attendez fin avril pour les semis sensibles.

question: Drought resilience strategy
variants: What agronomic practices minimize crop loss during a drought?
answer: Retain high mulch cover to stop surface evaporation, apply biochar to boost root water holding, plant drought-tolerant deep-rooted varieties, and practice deficit drip irrigation during critical flowering stages.
answer_en: Retain high mulch cover to stop surface evaporation, apply biochar to boost root water holding, plant drought-tolerant deep-rooted varieties, and practice deficit drip irrigation during critical flowering stages.
answer_fr: Maintenez un paillage épais contre l'évaporation, incorporez du compost/biochar pour décupler la réserve utile du sol et choisissez des variétés à enracinement profond.

question: Evapotranspiration (ET0)
answer: ET0 represents the water loss from soil evaporation and plant transpiration under standard grass conditions. Comparing ET0 to precipitation indicates your parcel's immediate water deficit.
answer_en: ET0 represents the water loss from soil evaporation and plant transpiration under standard grass conditions. Comparing ET0 to precipitation indicates your parcel's immediate water deficit.
answer_fr: L'ET0 mesure la perte en eau cumulée par évaporation du sol et transpiration des plantes. Comparée aux précipitations reçues, elle chiffre précisément le déficit hydrique de votre parcelle.

question: Heavy rain soil erosion
variants: How can I protect steep slopes from rain erosion?
answer: Install contour swales, plant vetiver or hedgerows along contour lines, maintain permanent vegetation cover, and avoid down-slope furrow plowing.
answer_en: Install contour swales, plant vetiver or hedgerows along contour lines, maintain permanent vegetation cover, and avoid down-slope furrow plowing.
answer_fr: Aménagez des cordons de vétiver ou des haies selon les courbes de niveau, gardez un couvert permanent et ne labourez jamais dans le sens de la pente.

question: Growing Degree Days (GDD)
answer: GDD measures heat accumulation above a base temperature (e.g. 10°C for maize). It accurately predicts crop development stages, flowering, and physiological maturity.
answer_en: GDD measures heat accumulation above a base temperature (e.g. 10°C for maize). It accurately predicts crop development stages, flowering, and physiological maturity.
answer_fr: Les DJC (Degrés Jours de Croissance) mesurent le cumul de chaleur au-dessus du seuil végétatif (ex: 10°C pour le maïs), prédisant précisément la date de floraison et de maturité.

question: Hail risk mitigation
answer: In orchards and high-value crops, hail nets provide physical protection. In open fields, broad insurance coverage and crop diversification spread hail impact risk.

question: Interpreting Soil pH
variants: What does a soil pH of 6.5 mean for my crops?
answer: A pH of 6.5 is near-neutral and considered the agronomic sweet spot for most temperate and tropical crops. Macronutrients (N, P, K, Ca, Mg) are fully available without aluminum toxicity.
answer_en: A pH of 6.5 is near-neutral and considered the agronomic sweet spot for most temperate and tropical crops. Macronutrients (N, P, K, Ca, Mg) are fully available without aluminum toxicity.

question: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC)
variants: What is CEC and why does it indicate soil fertility?
answer: CEC measures the soil's ability to hold and exchange essential mineral cations (Ca++, Mg++, K+, NH4+). Soils with high clay and organic matter have high CEC (> 20 cmol/kg), preventing nutrient leaching.
answer_en: CEC measures the soil's ability to hold and exchange essential mineral cations (Ca++, Mg++, K+, NH4+). Soils with high clay and organic matter have high CEC (> 20 cmol/kg), preventing nutrient leaching.
answer_fr: La CEC mesure le réservoir d'éléments nutritifs échangeables (Ca++, Mg++, K+, NH4+). Une CEC supérieure à 20 cmol/kg traduit un sol riche en argile et humus évitant le lessivage des engrais.

question: Soil texture triangle
variants: What is the difference between sandy, loamy, and clayey soils?
answer: Sandy soils drain rapidly but hold few nutrients; clay soils hold abundant water and nutrients but risk compaction; loamy soils offer an ideal balance of aeration, permeability, and fertility.
answer_en: Sandy soils drain rapidly but hold few nutrients; clay soils hold abundant water and nutrients but risk compaction; loamy soils offer an ideal balance of aeration, permeability, and fertility.
answer_fr: Les sols sableux drainent vite mais retiennent peu les nutriments ; les sols argileux stockent eau et éléments mais compactent ; les limons offrent un équilibre optimal mais craignent la battance.

question: Ferralsols in Diana
variants: What are the characteristics of Ferralsol soils in Diana, Madagascar?
answer: Ferralsols (red tropical soils) are deep and well-drained, rich in iron and aluminum oxides, but naturally acidic with low phosphorus availability. They benefit greatly from compost and rock phosphate.
answer_en: Ferralsols (red tropical soils) are deep and well-drained, rich in iron and aluminum oxides, but naturally acidic with low phosphorus availability. They benefit greatly from compost and rock phosphate.
answer_fr: Les Ferralsols (sols rouges tropicaux) sont profonds et bien drainés mais naturellement acides et carencés en phosphore disponible. Ils nécessitent des apports réguliers de compost et phosphate naturel.

question: Cambisols in Gutland
variants: What are the characteristics of Cambisols in Luxembourg's Gutland?
answer: Cambisols are fertile, moderately weathered soils with structured B horizons. In Gutland, they are often calcaric or eutric, naturally rich in bases and ideal for winter wheat and rapeseed.
answer_en: Cambisols are fertile, moderately weathered soils with structured B horizons. In Gutland, they are often calcaric or eutric, naturally rich in bases and ideal for winter wheat and rapeseed.
answer_fr: Les Cambisols du Bon Pays (Gutland) sont des sols bruns profonds, bien structurés et modérément calciques, particulièrement fertiles pour les céréales et le colza d'hiver.

question: Vertisols in Ambilobe
variants: Why are Vertisols in Ambilobe challenging but productive?
answer: Vertisols contain expanding smectite clays that crack deeply when dry and swell into sticky, impermeable mass when wet. They are exceptionally fertile for sugarcane and irrigated paddy when drained properly.
answer_en: Vertisols contain expanding smectite clays that crack deeply when dry and swell into sticky, impermeable mass when wet. They are exceptionally fertile for sugarcane and irrigated paddy when drained properly.
answer_fr: Les Vertisols d'Ambilobe contiennent des argiles gonflantes qui se fissurent en saison sèche et deviennent imperméables à l'eau. Bien drainés, ils sont très fertiles pour la canne et le riz.

question: Why recommend rapeseed (colza)?
variants: Why is winter rapeseed recommended for Luxembourg parcelles?
answer: Rapeseed yields ~3.9 t/ha with high oil content and stable European market prices (~510 €/t). It has a deep taproot that breaks cereal monoculture, improves soil structure, and reduces weed pressure.
answer_en: Rapeseed yields ~3.9 t/ha with high oil content and stable European market prices (~510 €/t). It has a deep taproot that breaks cereal monoculture, improves soil structure, and reduces weed pressure.

question: Why recommend winter wheat?
variants: When should I plant winter wheat in Gutland?
answer: Winter wheat thrives on Gutland's deep silty Cambisols when sown between October and November. It yields 5.5 to 7.0 t/ha, though nitrogen fertilizer prices require careful margin management.
answer_en: Winter wheat thrives on Gutland's deep silty Cambisols when sown between October and November. It yields 5.5 to 7.0 t/ha, though nitrogen fertilizer prices require careful margin management.
answer_fr: Le blé d'hiver valorise parfaitement les Cambisols limoneux du Gutland semé en octobre-novembre. Il atteint 5,5 à 7 t/ha, sous réserve d'ajuster la fertilisation azotée face aux coûts.

question: Why recommend cassava (manioc)?
variants: Why is cassava strongly recommended in Antsiranana?
answer: Cassava is extraordinarily resilient to erratic rainfall, high temperatures, and poor soils. It produces 12-25 t/ha of energy-rich tubers, providing critical food security and financial safety during cyclone years.
answer_en: Cassava is extraordinarily resilient to erratic rainfall, high temperatures, and poor soils. It produces 12-25 t/ha of energy-rich tubers, providing critical food security and financial safety during cyclone years.
answer_fr: Le manioc résiste exceptionnellement bien aux sécheresses et aux sols pauvres. Il produit 12 à 25 t/ha de tubercules nutritifs, constituant une sécurité vivrière et financière majeure face aux cyclones.

question: Why recommend vanilla in Diana?
variants: What conditions make Diana ideal for Bourbon Vanilla?
answer: Diana offers the warm, humid tropical microclimate (22-30°C, > 1200mm rain) and shade-tree agroforestry systems required by Vanilla planifolia, delivering world-class aromatic quality and high export value.
answer_en: Diana offers the warm, humid tropical microclimate (22-30°C, > 1200mm rain) and shade-tree agroforestry systems required by Vanilla planifolia, delivering world-class aromatic quality and high export value.
answer_fr: La région Diana réunit la chaleur et l'hygrométrie idéales (22-30°C, >1200 mm) ainsi que les forêts sous ombrage propices à la vanille Bourbon, à très haute valeur d'exportation.
